description: This file defines a PHP script for rendering a subpanel view in SuiteCRM, specifically for managing prospect lists within campaigns. It includes form generation, JavaScript interactions, and list view setup.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in SuiteCRM, used here to display prospect lists in the subpanel.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the list view with a specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the XTemplate used for rendering.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text or HTML content for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data.
